domain.description: The domain that was checked, lowercase.

available.description: true = not registered, false = registered, null = could not be determined.

method.description: How the answer was reached: dns (decided by nameservers, or DNS only when the TLD has no RDAP server) or rdap (confirmed by the registry).

hasDns.description: true if the domain has nameservers in DNS, false if not, null if the DNS lookup failed.

nameservers.description: Nameservers from DNS, lowercase. Empty if none.

registrar.description: Registrar name from RDAP. Null unless an RDAP lookup was made for a registered domain.

createdDate.description: Registration date (YYYY-MM-DD) from RDAP, or null.

expiryDate.description: Expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD) from RDAP, or null.

domainAgeYears.description: Age in years since the registration date, from RDAP, or null.

rdapStatus.description: EPP status codes from RDAP. Empty unless an RDAP lookup was made.

keyword.description: The keyword this name was built from, or null for names you pasted as Domains.

tld.description: The last label of the domain (for example com).

length.description: Length of the first label (the name without the TLD).

error.description: Note when the answer is incomplete (for example RDAP inconclusive, or no RDAP server so the result is DNS-only). Null otherwise.

parkedOrForSale.description: Parking or marketplace service detected from the nameservers (for example Afternic, Sedo, Dan.com), or null.
